gloss: fee; bill; charge; age range; decade (suffix)

definitions.gloss: fee; bill; charge for a service or item
definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to name the cost, fee, or bill for that thing or service: {電気|でんき}{代|だい} (electricity bill), {食事|しょくじ}{代|だい} (the cost of a meal).

Attached to a multiple of ten to name a ten-year span of ages (50{代|だい}, 'in one's fifties'; {二十代|にじゅうだい}, 'in one's twenties'), or, as 〜{年代|ねんだい}, to name a decade (1990{年代|ねんだい}, 'the 1990s'). The same 代 appears in {世代|せだい} (generation) and {時代|じだい} (era).

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}{代|だい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid this month's heating bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧{代|だい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}たせて→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Please let us pay for the meal.
My father is in his fifties.
Most of this shop's customers are women in their twenties.

examples.japanese: 1990⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流行|はや}った→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Music that was popular in the 1990s has lately become popular again with the younger generation.

notes:
Two separate uses share this suffix: sense 1 names the bill or fee for a thing, sense 2 a span of ages or years.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}{代|だい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧: electricity bill
- ⟦ガス{代|だい}→ガス代：08943_gasudai⟧: gas bill
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}{代|だい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧: water bill
- ⟦{飲|の}み{代|だい}→飲み代：29658_nomidai⟧: drinking tab; bar bill
- ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧{代|だい}: taxi fare
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧{代|だい}: room charge

USAGE:
In sense 2, 〜{代|だい} covers the whole ten-year span: 50{代|だい} is anyone from 50 to 59, and 10{代|だい} (also ⟦{十代|じゅうだい}→十代：16244_juudai⟧) means roughly the teens. ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧ and ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧ narrow it: 30{代|だい}⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧ (early thirties), 40{代|だい}⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧ (late forties). With a year, use 〜⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧: 1980⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧ (the 1980s).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: fee; charge — more formal; used for fixed institutional fees (⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}{料|りょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧ tuition)
- 〜⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: expense — refers to a category of spending (⟦{生活|せいかつ}{費|ひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧ living expenses)
- 〜⟦{賃|ちん}→〜賃：28343_chin⟧: fare; rent — used for transport fares and rent (⟦{家|や}{賃|ちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ rent)
